_comment: Hans's wolf quest: kill 6 wolves, report to Hans, who sends the player to the Town Crier, who sends them on to the Governor of Dionsburg. The Governor's turn-in pays, the L9 half-level rule at L3 (the pasture wolves). Count and reward [PLACEHOLDER].
title: He Who Cried Wolf

stages.journal: The shepherd tasked you with killing 6 wolves that found their way to the farmlands.
Six wolves are dead. Hans should hear of it.
Hans is uneasy about so many wolves. He sent you to the Town Crier, close to Reinhard's farm.
The Town Crier advised you to tell the Governor of Dionsburg about the rising numbers of wolves in the farmlands. Maybe they know what causes it there.
stages.tracker: Talk to the Governor of Dionsburg

stages.journal: The Governor of Dionsburg has heard about the wolves.
